summary: In the hovercraft, disoriented and with no sense of time, Neo overhears Morpheus and Trinity whispering. Morpheus announces to Trinity, 'We've done it... We found him,' and when Trinity says 'I hope you're right,' he replies, 'I don't have to hope it. I know it.' Neo's eyes flutter open to see Morpheus' face above him, 'angelic in the fluorescent glow of a light stick.' Neo asks, '... am I dead?' and Morpheus answers, 'Far from it.'

what_changes.before: Unconscious, half-conscious, with no sense of time and only voices heard
what_changes.after: Regains consciousness, eyes opening to see Morpheus above him and engaging in speech
what_changes.evidence: Neo's eyes flutter open.  We see Morpheus' face above us

what_changes.before: Disoriented and unaware of his fate, wondering if he has died
